topic_title: Human Trafficking Awareness — The Julia Wells Act
prompt: Which observable indicators suggest that an individual at a highway rest stop may be a trafficking victim?

options.text: Wearing comfortable athletic jogging clothes while purchasing bottled water
Driving a clean, modern commercial tractor-trailer equipped with GPS navigation
Paying for gasoline at a travel center fuel pump using a valid credit card
Fearful/submissive behavior, scripted answers, lack of ID, and controlled by another
